# XdrLogRaider — Connector Health

**What this dashboard shows:** Operator-facing observability for the XdrLogRaider connector — auth chain status, ingestion rates, DLQ backpressure, per-tier freshness, per-stream last-row markers, and service account sign-in baseline.

**Use cases:**
- **Daily SOC stand-up**: connector card status; any tier stale; auth health green
- **On-call runbook**: 5-min triage when connector card flips Disconnected
- **Capacity planning**: ingestion volume trends per stream + tier
- **Cost monitoring**: row-volume baseline + spike detection
- **Service account governance**: sign-in anomaly review

**Panels:**
1. Per-tier last-fresh poll markers (5 capability tiers + heartbeat)
2. Auth chain failures last 24h (AppExceptions filtered to AuthChain.*)
3. DLQ depth and oldest-entry age
4. Freshness SLI per consolidated category
5. Per-row partial-success rate per stream
6. Service account sign-in anomaly summary (uses $(SERVICE_ACCOUNT_UPN) deployment parameter)
7. Per-stream freshness (workspace-side last row per SourceName across 10 category tables)

**Data sources:** `XdrConnectorHealth_CL` + `AppExceptions` + `AppMetrics` + all 10 `Defender_<Category>_CL` workspace tables.

For triage workflows see [docs/RUNBOOK.md](https://github.com/akefallonitis/xdrlograider/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md).

content.query:
XdrConnectorHealth_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(Tier)
| summarize LastSeenUtc = max(TimeGenerated), HeartbeatCount = count(), TotalRowsIngested = sum(RowsIngested) by Tier
| extend StaleMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastSeenUtc)
| extend Status = case(
    Tier == 'Heartbeat'      and StaleMinutes <= 10,    'Healthy',
    Tier == 'ActionCenter'   and StaleMinutes <= 20,    'Healthy',
    Tier == 'XspmGraph'      and StaleMinutes <= 120,   'Healthy',
    Tier == 'Configuration'  and StaleMinutes <= 720,   'Healthy',
    Tier == 'Inventory'      and StaleMinutes <= 2880,  'Healthy',
    Tier == 'Maintenance'    and StaleMinutes <= 20160, 'Healthy',
    'Stale'
)
| project Tier, Status, StaleMinutes, LastSeenUtc, HeartbeatCount, TotalRowsIngested
| sort by Tier asc
content.title: Per-tier poll freshness (last vs cadence threshold)

content.query:
AppExceptions
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend ErrorClass = tostring(Properties.ErrorClass)
| where ErrorClass startswith 'AuthChain.'
| summarize FailureCount = count() by ErrorClass, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| render timechart
content.title: Auth chain failures over time (AppExceptions where ErrorClass startswith AuthChain.)
DLQ depth + pending_count + pop rate over time (B3)

content.query:
AppMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Name == 'xdr.ingest.row_age_seconds'
| extend Stream = tostring(Properties.Stream)
| summarize p95FreshnessSeconds = percentile(Max, 95) by Stream
| sort by p95FreshnessSeconds desc
content.title: Freshness SLI per stream (p95 row age in seconds)

content.query:
AppMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Name == 'xdr.ingest.row_success_rate'
| extend Stream = tostring(Properties.Stream)
| summarize MinSuccessRate = min(Min), AvgSuccessRate = avg(Sum / toreal(ItemCount)) by Stream
| extend Health = case(MinSuccessRate >= 0.99, 'Healthy', MinSuccessRate >= 0.90, 'Degraded', 'Failed')
| sort by MinSuccessRate asc
content.title: Per-stream partial-success rate (min/avg in window)
Service account sign-in activity (uses $(SERVICE_ACCOUNT_UPN) deployment parameter — see XdrOps-ServiceAccountAnomalousSignIn rule)

content.query:
// Per-stream workspace-side freshness: last TimeGenerated per SourceName across
// all 10 consolidated Defender_<Category>_CL tables (architecture).
// Operators use this to spot a stream that's stopped landing rows even when the
// poll function is firing (e.g., portal API change, partial DCR rejection).
union isfuzzy=true
    Defender_EndpointDeviceManagement_CL,
    Defender_EndpointConfiguration_CL,
    Defender_VulnerabilityManagement_CL,
    Defender_IdentityProtection_CL,
    Defender_ConfigurationAndSettings_CL,
    Defender_ExposureManagement_CL,
    Defender_ThreatAnalytics_CL,
    Defender_ActionCenter_CL,
    Defender_MultiTenantOperations_CL,
    Defender_StreamingApi_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize LastSeenUtc = max(TimeGenerated), RowsLast24h = countif(TimeGenerated > ago(24h)) by SourceName
| extend StaleMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastSeenUtc)
| extend Status = case(
    StaleMinutes <= 60,    'Fresh',
    StaleMinutes <= 1440,  'StaleHourly',
    StaleMinutes <= 10080, 'StaleDaily',
    'NoData'
)
| project SourceName, Status, StaleMinutes, LastSeenUtc, RowsLast24h
| sort by StaleMinutes desc
content.title: Per-stream freshness (workspace-side) — last row landed per SourceName across 10 category tables
